# Zachs

> Zachs is a plant nursery based in Lurgan, County Armagh, Northern Ireland,
> selling healthy houseplants, outdoor plants, succulents & cacti, pots &
> planters, plant care essentials and gift sets, with delivery across
> Northern Ireland and local collection from the nursery.

Zachs hand-packs every plant at its Lurgan nursery. Free delivery applies to
Northern Ireland orders over £45 (a flat £4.95 courier charge otherwise), and
every plant is covered by a 30-day healthy-on-arrival guarantee. Local
delivery and collection cover Lurgan, Craigavon, Portadown, Armagh,
Banbridge and Belfast.

## Shop

- [All plants](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop): the full catalogue, filterable by category.
- [Houseplants](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop?category=houseplants): air-purifying, statement-making leaves for every room.
- [Outdoor Plants](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop?category=outdoor-plants): hardy, garden-ready plants that thrive outside.
- [Succulents & Cacti](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop?category=succulents-cacti): low-maintenance shapes for sunny windowsills.
- [Pots & Planters](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop?category=pots-planters): ceramic, terracotta and woven homes for plants.
- [Plant Care](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop?category=plant-care): feeds, tools and tonics to keep everything thriving.
- [Gift Sets](https://www.zachs.co.uk/shop?category=gift-sets): curated bundles, ready to arrive beautifully boxed.

## Guides

- [Care Guides](https://www.zachs.co.uk/care-guides): plant-by-plant light, water and care advice.
